about: Answer key for the figure reader and `figure.form` (step 2B, PRs 4a and 4b), written by the controller by reading, the cases adapted from the predecessor's tests and the coordinator's rulings A to K of 2026-11-14. `iso_4217` is the predecessor's list of 176 currency codes. `reader`: each row gives a line of text, the sides it is read on (`passage`: dates and period labels masked; `held`: read as written) and the figures expected in order, each [value, negative, bracketed, unit, currency, shown, column]; value is a decimal string compared as a Decimal (`4.1` equals `4.10`), column the 1-based position of `shown` in the text; unit and currency are null when nothing is written and `unrecognised` when something is written that is not an accepted form; a row with `known_reading` records a reading that is known to be wrong and is not closed. `cases`: documents built as in prose.json (`front` + head + `findings` + `tail`; the head is six lines, so the text under a leading `### Bottom line` is line 8; `kind` defaults to data); each expected finding is [check, severity, line, quoted]; `columns`, when given, lists the column of each finding in order; `reason_has` is compared when given. The findings of a case are compared whole and in order.
